sources.summary: The Pedra Azul House establishes a direct and continuous relationship with nature. Set on a narrow, sloping lot, the topography was a determining factor in organizing the architectural program. The project consists of independent modules connected by wide circulation areas, fostering horizontality and a fragmentation of volumes that gently adapts to the terrain.
